title: Calendar
overview: This guide covers calendar workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Visit Type
subtasks.purpose: Define the visit types (e.g., new patient, follow-up, telehealth) available when booking on the practice calendar, along with their duration and colour code.

steps.title: Open Visit Type
steps.description: Click Calendar in the sidebar and choose Visit Type from the Calendar Setting fly-out.

steps.title: Review Visit Type List
steps.description: Review existing entries in the Visit Type List (columns: #, Practice Name, Visit Type, Visit Type Description, Duration, Status, Color, Action). The empty state reads “No visit types found”.

steps.title: Add Visit Type
steps.description: Click + Add Visit Type (top-right).

steps.title: Enter Visit Type Details
steps.description: In the modal, enter Visit Type name, Description, Duration (in minutes) and pick a Color swatch.

steps.title: Set Visit Type Status
steps.description: Set Status to Active (or Inactive to hide the type without deleting it).

steps.title: Save Visit Type
steps.description: Click Save.

steps.title: Edit or Delete Visit Type
steps.description: To edit or remove a row, use the pencil / trash icons in the Action column.

steps.title: Search or Page Visit Types
steps.description: Use the Search box to filter by name or the Show N entries dropdown to change page size. Notes Duration drives the default appointment length on the calendar grid — a 30-minute visit type will span two 15-minute slots. The Color you pick is the block colour shown on the calendar and in day / week views. Inactive visit types are hidden from the appointment booking dropdown but remain on past appointments.

subtasks.title: Working Hours
subtasks.purpose: Define the practice’s office hours (per day, within a date range) so that the calendar only offers bookable slots inside those windows.

steps.title: Open Working Hours
steps.description: Click Calendar → Working Hours.

steps.title: Set Schedule Start/End Date
steps.description: In the Office Hours panel, pick Start Date (required) and End Date using the mm/dd/yyyy pickers. Leave End Date blank for an open-ended schedule.

steps.title: Enable Working Days
steps.description: For each day (Sun–Sat) tick the checkbox to enable that day.

steps.title: Set Start & End Times
steps.description: Set Start Time (default 09:00 AM) and End Time (default 05:00 PM) using the time pickers in the Days / Start Time / End Time grid.

steps.title: Add or Remove Time Block
steps.description: Click the + icon in the Action column to add an additional time block for that day (e.g., a morning and an afternoon shift split around lunch); use the – icon to remove a block.

steps.title: Repeat for Each Day
steps.description: Repeat for every working day.

steps.title: Save Working Hours
steps.description: Click Save (bottom-left) to persist the schedule. Notes Days left unticked render as unavailable on the calendar (no bookable slots). Start Date is required; the schedule applies from that date forward until End Date or until Working Hours is edited again. Multiple blocks per day let you model split shifts — the calendar simply hides the slots between blocks.

subtasks.title: Calendar (view & book appointments)
subtasks.purpose: View the practice’s appointment grid by week or list, and book / edit appointments against configured visit types and caregivers.

steps.title: Open Calendar
steps.description: Click Calendar → Calendar.

steps.title: Navigate Between Months
steps.description: Use the month grid on the left to pick a date; « / » page between months, Clear resets the selection and Today jumps back to the current date.

steps.title: Change Slot Granularity
steps.description: Change the slot granularity with the 15 Minutes dropdown (top of the right pane) — options include 15, 30 and 60 minute slots.

steps.title: Refresh Appointments
steps.description: Use the ↻ refresh icon to reload the day’s appointments.

steps.title: Toggle Week/List View
steps.description: Toggle Week / List (top-right of the day header) to switch between the calendar grid and a chronological list.

steps.title: View Selected Date Panel
steps.description: The right pane shows the selected date header (e.g., “July 22, 2026”) and either the appointment grid or “No working hours available for this day.” when the day is outside the Working Hours schedule.

steps.title: Book an Appointment
steps.description: Click an empty slot to open the Book Appointment dialog: pick Patient, Visit Type (colour-coded), Caregiver and add notes, then Save.

steps.title: Reschedule or Cancel Visit
steps.description: Click an existing appointment block to reschedule, reassign or cancel.

steps.title: Review Caregiver Availability
steps.description: The System Caregivers panel (below the month grid) lists caregivers available for assignment — “No caregivers available” indicates none are mapped to this practice. Notes The message “No working hours available for this day.” means Working Hours has that weekday unticked or the date is outside the Start/End range — fix it under Calendar → Working Hours. Slot colours match the Visit Type colour configured in 7.13.1. List view is useful for printing a day sheet; Week view is best for booking. Task 7.14 — Messages
